first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: In frame 0 of this clip, Person A is in the left foreground. The person has short dark hair, wears a blue-gray shirt with rolled-up sleeves and brownish-tan trousers, and has brown crossed shoulder straps; tracked by clothing and continuous action, and the position may change with the camera.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The other person who continuously interacts with Person A in this clip. The person has relatively short gray-brown hair and wears a dark crew-neck short-sleeved shirt and dark trousers; does not have Person A's crossed shoulder straps and continuously interacts with Person A while holding a sword.

entities.name: Sword A
entities.identification: The sword held by Person A, identified by Person A's holding relationship and continuous action; a long curved blade and a metal guard near the hand are visible.

entities.name: Sword B
entities.identification: The sword held by Person B, identified by Person B's holding relationship and continuous action; its designation does not change based on being at the top or bottom of the image or on momentary reflections.

entities.name: Wooden Plank Floor
entities.identification: The continuous wooden plank surface beneath the people and between them, with seams between the planks extending into the distance; does not include the stairs above, the Pillar, or scattered metal objects.

entities.name: Metal Debris on the Ground
entities.identification: The collection of disk-shaped and irregular small metal objects scattered or piled on the Wooden Plank Floor; individual objects are not numbered, and Sparks from Clashing Swords in the air are not included.

entities.name: Pillar
entities.identification: The thick upright columnar structural elements indoors, visible at the sides and in the background; defined separately from the closely spaced rods of the Grating.

entities.name: Background Wall Rack
entities.identification: The background structure composed of large dark wall surfaces, frame edges, and elevated beam racks behind the people, excluding the separately defined Pillar, Grating, Background Stairs, and Box.

entities.name: Background Stairs
entities.identification: The stairs in the background composed of several horizontal steps that rise progressively, located behind the people and not including ordinary floorboard seams.

entities.name: Box
entities.identification: The collection of low rectangular box-shaped containers in the background, with square frames, metal edges, and open or tilted lid surfaces visible; only the areas visible in this clip are counted.

entities.name: Flames
entities.identification: The orange-yellow tongues of fire visible near the Pillar, wall rack, and background edges; does not include the white flashes and brief sparks that appear when the swords clash.

entities.name: Sparks from Clashing Swords
entities.identification: The bright specks and short streaks that briefly scatter near where the two swords meet, appearing and dissipating with the sword-clashing action; does not include stationary Metal Debris on the Ground or environmental Flames.
